ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black (approx. 70%) with high-intensity white patches (approx. 30%) localized at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white blobs located on the far lateral distal tips of both lobes; internal speckling of low-intensity pixels within these white regions. The central and peduncle-adjacent areas are solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; angle approximately 35-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations visible along the entire trailing edge; distinct peaks and valleys with pixel-depth variation of 10-20 pixels relative to the lobe plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to tapered, pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, isolated high-intensity circular clusters (approx. 3-5 pixels in diameter) scattered across the dark regions of the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Highly distinct parallel linear rake marks; a cluster of 5-6 parallel diagonal lines on the right lobe (lower quadrant) and a denser set of overlapping linear disruptions on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across both lobes; no visible evidence of trailing edge amputation or parasitic lesions.
